title: Devices & Obsidian
description: Syncthing keeps the notes and files of Home, the projects and Private/ in sync with Obsidian on your Mac and phone: directly at home, through encrypted relays on the road.

guide.title: Set up a device
guide.step1: Install Syncthing and Obsidian on the device. Mac: the app Syncthing from syncthing.net. iPhone: Möbius Sync from the App Store. Android: Syncthing-Fork from F-Droid or Google Play.
guide.step2: In Syncthing, add a device and enter this server's device ID, or scan the QR code.
guide.step2Lan: For direct syncing at home, enter {address}, dynamic as the device's addresses.
guide.step3: The device then appears above under “Devices asking to connect”. Choose Accept.
guide.step4: On the device, accept the folder Helena into a folder named Helena: ~/Helena on the Mac, Helena in the internal storage on Android, the Obsidian vault Helena on the iPhone.
guide.step5: Wait until the folder shows “Up to date” on the device, then open the folder Helena in Obsidian as a vault. Links from Helena open the vault Helena.
guide.iphone: Obsidian on the iPhone only opens its own folders. First create the vault Helena in Obsidian (on the iPhone, not in iCloud) and close Obsidian. Then, in Möbius Sync, put the folder Helena into On My iPhone › Obsidian › Helena. Obsidian writes its own settings when it creates a vault, so conflicts in .obsidian can appear after the first sync; their conflict copies hold this server's defaults. Möbius Sync syncs while the app is open or iOS lets it run in the background.
guide.space: Ignore patterns apply only on the device where they are entered. To keep the mail files off the phone, open the folder Helena in Möbius Sync or Syncthing-Fork, add the line Files/Mail under Ignore Patterns and save, best right after accepting the folder. The files stay on this server and the other devices.
